tokens: "You are about to embark on a thrilling journey that will take you through dangerous forests, treacherous swamps, and dark dungeons.\n"
"Your goal is to defeat the final boss and save the kingdom from his evil clutches.\n\n"
"Get ready to face your fears and make some tough choices...\n\n"
"You find yourself in a dense forest.\n"
"The air is thick with the sounds of rustling leaves and chirping birds.\n"
"You see a path leading deeper into the forest, and a small river off to your left.\n"
"You follow the path deeper into the forest.\n"
"The trees get thicker and the light gets dimmer.\n"
"You cautiously approach the source of the noises.\n"
"Suddenly, a giant spider jumps out at you!\n"
"You draw your sword and prepare for battle.\n"
"You decide to turn back and explore a different part of the forest.\n"
"You follow the river, enjoying the peaceful sound of the water.\n"
"You peek around a tree and see a huge bear.\n"
"1. Try to sneak past the bear\n"
"You try to sneak past the bear, but he catches your scent and charges at you!\n"
"You draw your sword and prepare for battle.\n"
"You draw your sword and run at the bear, ready to fight.\n"
"The bear is no match for your strength and you defeat him easily.\n"
"You decide to turn back and explore a different part of the forest.\n"
"The air is thick with the smell of rotting vegetation.\n"
"You see a path leading deeper into the swamp, and a small boat off to your right.\n"
"You follow the path deeper into the swamp.\n"
"The ground becomes mushy and your feet sink in with each step.\n"
"You cautiously approach the source of the noises.\n"
"Suddenly, a giant alligator jumps out at you!\n"
"You draw your sword and prepare for battle.\n"
"You decide to turn back and explore a different part of the swamp.\n"
"You take the boat, paddling through the murky water.\n"
"Suddenly, you hear a loud hissing sound!\n"
"You look around and see a giant snake coiled up in a nearby tree.\n"
"1. Shoot the snake with an arrow\n"
"2. Row away as fast as possible\n"
"You shoot the snake with an arrow, but it dodges and charges at you!\n"
"You draw your sword and prepare for battle.\n"
"You row away as fast as possible, narrowly avoiding the snake's attack.\n"
"You decide to turn back and explore a different part of the swamp.\n"
"You see a hallway leading deeper into the dungeon, and a staircase going up.\n"
"You follow the hallway deeper into the dungeon.\n"
"You cautiously approach the source of the noises.\n"
"Suddenly, a group of goblins ambushes you!\n"
"You draw your sword and prepare for battle.\n"
"You decide to turn back and explore a different part of the dungeon.\n"
"You go up the staircase and find yourself in a large chamber.\n"
"There is a treasure chest in the center of the room.\n"
"You open the treasure chest and find a rare magic amulet!\n"
"You decide to leave the treasure chest alone and explore a different part of the dungeon.\n"
"You find yourself face to face with the final boss.\n"
"The evil sorcerer, Zoltar, raises his staff and charges at you!\n"
"2. Use the magic amulet to defeat Zoltar\n"
"You charge at Zoltar with your sword, but he deflects your blows with magic spells.\n"
"You are no match for his dark powers and he defeats you easily.\n"
"You use the magic amulet to channel powerful magic spells at Zoltar.\n"
"Zoltar is overwhelmed by your powers and falls to the ground defeated.\n"
"Congratulations! You have saved the kingdom from his evil clutches.\n"
"Press any key to exit the game...\n"
